title: Locally constant sheaf on the pro-etale site
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $A$ a commutative ring, and $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ the small pro-étale site of $Y$ with its constant sheaf of rings $A_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For a $A$-module $M$, the *constant sheaf* $\underline M_Y$ is the sheafification of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto M$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, a sheaf of $A_Y$-modules. A sheaf $\mathcal F$ of $A_Y$-modules on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is *constant* if it is isomorphic to $\underline M_Y$ for some $A$-module $M$, and *locally constant* if there is a covering $\{U_j\to Y\}_j$ in $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ such that, for every $j$, the restriction $\mathcal F|_{U_j}$ to the localized site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}/U_j\simeq(U_j)_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is constant.

source.place: Bhatt-Scholze, The pro-étale topology for schemes, Definition 7.3.1(1) (stated there for sheaves of sets on X_proét, X locally topologically noetherian); the module version is the blueprint's (node def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties)
